title: Concept: Conda channel priority relaxed
description: .condarc declares a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version.
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version.
